lines.zh: 六颗头一起往前，地上没有影子敢留。
lines.en: Six heads move as one and no shadow dares stay.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把碎石压成粉。
lines.en: My steps grind the gravel to powder.

lines.zh: 我走一步，树就往两边倒。
lines.en: One step and the trees lean away.

lines.zh: 六条脖子各看一个方向。
lines.en: Six necks watch six directions.
My tail drags across a stand of ferns.
I move slowly because I am too large.
A rot-reek spreads off me.

lines.zh: 我跨过一条沟，沟太窄了。
lines.en: I stride over a gully. It is too narrow.

lines.zh: 每颗头都在呼吸，声音很乱。
lines.en: Every head breathes and the sound is tangled.
As I advance the birds stop calling.
The soil sinks under my tread.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头，走起来吱响。
lines.en: This frame of bone creaks as it moves.
I turn and snap a tree in passing.

lines.zh: 我的影子覆盖了整条小路。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole path.

lines.zh: 我朝着有活物的方向走。
lines.en: I walk toward whatever is alive.
Step by step, and the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 我站着，六颗头在互相看。
lines.en: I stand and six heads look at each other.

lines.zh: 腐肉挂在我身上，我不管。
lines.en: Rotting flesh hangs on me. I ignore it.
Six heads turn to you at once.

lines.zh: 有一颗头在低吼，别的跟着。
lines.en: One head growls and the others follow.
This forest is too short for me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，树冠刚好挡住天。
lines.en: I look up. The canopy just blocks the sky.
My joints grind against each other.

lines.zh: 六颗头里有一颗总在偏。
lines.en: One of the six always turns away.
The grass where I stand has withered.

lines.zh: 我在听，六只耳朵都在听。
lines.en: I listen with all six sets of ears.

lines.zh: 有一群鸟飞起来，我转头。
lines.en: A flock takes flight. Heads turn.

lines.zh: 我的骨头是白的，皮几乎没了。
lines.en: My bones are white and the hide is nearly gone.
Slowly I lower one head.

lines.zh: 这具身体不需要吃东西，也还在走。
lines.en: This body needs no food, yet it still walks.
You have six ways to die to choose from.
All six heads have seen you.

lines.zh: 你站在我脚边，像一只虫子。
lines.en: You stand by my feet like an insect.

lines.zh: 我的每一颗头都想先来。
lines.en: Every head of mine wants to go first.
That you do not run is strange.

lines.zh: 我身上的味道，你闻到了。
lines.en: You have caught my stench.

lines.zh: 我低头的时候，别抬头看。
lines.en: When I lower my heads, do not look up.

lines.zh: 这片林子只有你一个活物。
lines.en: You are the only living thing in this wood.
Standing, I am taller than the trees.
Which direction do you plan to run?

lines.zh: 这一下打在我一根肋骨上。
lines.en: That struck one of my ribs.
I have no hide to hurt.
One of my six heads is knocked askew.

lines.zh: 我转过身，六双眼睛找它。
lines.en: I turn and six pairs of eyes hunt it.
A mark is left on the bone.
Such a wound means nothing.
I take a step back and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我的关节响得更厉害了。
lines.en: My joints rattle louder.
That was the last time you touch me.
Every head has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 腐化的身子，早就尝不出味。
lines.en: This corrupted body has long lost its taste.

lines.zh: 那点血肉，撑不起这具身体。
lines.en: That much flesh cannot feed this body.

lines.zh: 我的六颗头都不感兴趣。
lines.en: None of my six heads is interested.
I am used to the smell of carrion.
I only want to see it move.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在地上，看我理不理。
lines.en: Leave it there and see if I care.

lines.zh: 这点分量，连塞牙都不够。
lines.en: Not enough to fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 我用一颗头闻了闻，转开了。
lines.en: One head sniffs and turns away.
Another head would try it.
Eat or not, the end is the same.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞石头。
lines.en: You hit my leg like stone.
I did not feel it at all.
Back off. I am stepping.
My foot comes down and the ground gives.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，自己弹了回去。
lines.en: You strike my leg and bounce back.
Do not stand between my legs.
I look down and you are still there.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，连皮都碰不到。
lines.en: That did not even reach my hide.
Six heads, six separate opinions.
Do not do that twice.
There is no male or female to this.
I was called up.
No kin, no offspring.

lines.zh: 六颗头各想各的，凑不到一起。
lines.en: Six heads each think elsewhere; they never agree.

lines.zh: 有一年，我以为看见了另一只。
lines.en: One year I thought I saw another.
It was only my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我不孤独，我不懂这个字。
lines.en: I am not lonely. I do not know that word.

lines.zh: 我的血是冷的，也不会变热。
lines.en: My blood is cold and will not warm.

lines.zh: 这种身体，生出什么都不对。
lines.en: What could this body bring forth? Nothing right.
Standing here will do.
One head lifts a bone.
I bite a whole stone to pieces.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，爪子拿不住。
lines.en: Too small for these claws.

lines.zh: 地上那点亮东西，我踩过去。
lines.en: That glimmer on the ground. I step on it.
I sweep it aside with my tail.

lines.zh: 六颗头一起低头，撞在一起。
lines.en: All six heads dip and knock together.

lines.zh: 我把它含在一颗头的嘴里。
lines.en: I hold it in one of my mouths.
None of this is of use to me.
I squeeze and it falls to powder.
I collect nothing.
Something warm is moving.

lines.zh: 六颗头同时朝一个方向。
lines.en: Six heads turn the same way at once.
That heartbeat is loud.
It stands in the clearing.

lines.zh: 我第一个头已经低下去了。
lines.en: My first head is already lowering.
The rest follow.
All six of my heads are watching you.
It glanced up at me.
It is backing away.
Retreat will not help. I am faster.

lines.zh: 我把六双眼睛都对准它。
lines.en: I fix all six pairs of eyes on it.
My reek reaches it first.
It hides behind a tree.
That tree is slender to me.
I am turning slowly toward it.
It goes left and one head follows.

lines.zh: 它往右，我另一颗头跟上。
lines.en: It goes right and another head tracks it.

lines.zh: 它以为只有一颗头在看。
lines.en: It thinks only one head is watching.
Something rustles in the grass.
I stop and lower all six heads.
It waits for me to stop moving.
Then we wait together.
Its breathing grows shorter.

lines.zh: 它开始往那个方向挪了。
lines.en: It has begun edging that way.
The trees are thick over there.
The first head strikes.
The second follows.
The third comes in from the side.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬合的声音像断木。
lines.en: The jaws close like snapping wood.

lines.zh: 六颗头一起低下去，咬住你。
lines.en: Six heads descend together and bite into you.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，整片草伏下。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and all the grass lies flat.
Six heads take turns without pause.
It tries to roll free and is held.
I lift it off the ground.

lines.zh: 第四颗头咬住了它的腿。
lines.en: The fourth head takes its leg.
The fifth tears.
The sixth only shrieks.

lines.zh: 六颗头一起从土里抬起来。
lines.en: Six heads rise out of the earth together.
I stand and the trees are shorter.

lines.zh: 土块从我骨头上滚下去。
lines.en: Clods of soil roll off my bones.
This clearing was left for me.
My breath thickens the air.
Six necks unfold slowly.
At the first roar the wood goes silent.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，遮了半片地。
lines.en: My shadow is long and covers half the ground.
The grass beneath me withers at once.
I step out of the summoning.

lines.zh: 这具身体不属于这个世界。
lines.en: This body does not belong to this world.
My joints crack and I take a step.
Six pairs of eyes open at once.

lines.zh: 空气里有腐烂和土的味道。
lines.en: The air smells of rot and earth.
Fire blackens my bone.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，砸出大坑。
lines.en: I fall from height and leave a wide crater.
Water pours into my hollow chest.

lines.zh: 爆响震掉了我一块骨头。
lines.en: The blast knocked a bone loose.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的肋骨间。
lines.en: Something is stuck between my ribs.

lines.zh: 召唤的光在抽我的力气。
lines.en: The summoning light is drawing my strength out.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这身体在衰。
lines.en: I do not eat, and yet this body fails.
Lightning ran the length of my spine.

lines.zh: 脚下的地开了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The ground opened and I fell through.
